component.name: ReVoiceOver
component.summary: Re-narrate a screen recording in your own voice

description.p: ReVoiceOver transcribes a video's narration, cleans the script with a language model (fillers, stutters, false starts, repeats), lets you review and edit it, then re-speaks it in a clone of your voice, timed to the original video. The result is a new video with clean narration and matching subtitles.
Speech recognition, script cleaning and voice synthesis run on DeepInfra with open models and need a DeepInfra API token. Media work runs locally.
